subject: TERMINATE statement
notes: cite.py --check 14.9.46.4 "does not close the file associated with report-name-1" -> OK §14.9.46.4 6). TerminateCore touches no connector state (only `_active`/`_started`); the file is closed by the program's own CLOSE. Probed out/probe/terminate-statement/p1.cob: after TERMINATE (twice) a CLOSE of the report file returns FILE STATUS 00 (a closed file would give 42), and a second INITIATE on the same still-open file succeeds; p3.cob likewise CLOSE FS=00. Terminate_Gr2 CLOSEs after TERMINATE but asserts no status, so it does not pin this rule. [editions as adjudicated: 1985 (Report Writer module), 2002, 2014, 2023]
